pattern: ^\d+ packages? ha(s|ve) newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints\.$
reason: Summary line of pub get. Every held-back package is still gated on its own line below, so a new one fails the check.
Pinned by the Flutter SDK (flutter / flutter_test). Resolves with the next Flutter SDK release.
Held by share_plus and file_selector (latest releases) which still require cross_file ^0.3.
Held by audio_service_mpris (latest release) which still requires dbus ^0.7.
Held by alarm (latest release) which still requires equatable ^2.
Dev tooling only: held by flutter_launcher_icons and msix (latest releases) which still require cli_util ^0.4.
smtc_windows 1.1.0 (latest) ships bindings generated with flutter_rust_bridge 2.11.1; see the override reason in pubspec.yaml. Ends with a smtc_windows release on 2.13 or our own fork.

pattern: ^WARNING: Your app uses the following plugins that apply Kotlin Gradle Plugin \(KGP\): alarm, home_widget$
reason: alarm 5.15.0 and home_widget 0.10.0 (latest) still apply KGP in their own Gradle files. Upstream reports are drafted; the Flutter tool prints this before Gradle runs, so no app-side change removes it.

pattern: ^Warning: Building for device with codesigning disabled\. You will have to manually codesign before deploying to device\.$
reason: The iOS job is an unsigned compile check by design (no signing secrets outside releases); Flutter prints this notice for every --no-codesign build.

pattern: ^Warning: 'no file associated with this alert' is not a valid URI in 'instance\.runs\[\d+\]\.results\[\d+\]\.locations\[0\]\.physicalLocation\.artifactLocation\.uri'\.$
reason: ossf/scorecard writes this placeholder URI for repository-level findings and github/codeql-action warns while uploading the SARIF. Reported upstream in the ossf/scorecard tracker (bug titled 'URI "no file associated with this alert" in SARIF now invalid in github/codeql-action'), closed there but still emitted by scorecard-action 2.5.0. The findings are uploaded; only the file location is dropped.
